essence: The divine sound in the throat encompasses completeness and unites transcendent and immanent aspects
The sound that rises from the lower center dissolves again at the twelvefold end
The reality above is free from stain, division, and all impurity
The supreme reality is a profound state to be known through great knowledge
The supreme reality encompasses both breath polarities and the polarity of being and nonbeing
